meta.description: Reserved seed asset for the Interior Door Configurator hinge library. Out of scope for the first release of the configurator (hinges are not currently inserted into 3D models), but the file establishes the folder structure, naming convention and unified asset schema so that future hinge work can be slotted in without reformatting. All units millimetres. Right-hand orientation.
meta.namingConvention: All custom keys prefixed Na__. Three-stage form Na__Section__SubSection__FieldName. Geometry primitives in Paths arrays use PathType (Line | Arc | Circle | Polygon).

fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks
fieldPrefixes.Na__PanelPlacement__: Door-panel mounting transforms (RH/LH handing, vertical datum)

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: Generic 100mm x 75mm two-leaf butt hinge - placeholder seed asset establishing the unified hinge schema. Geometry blocks are intentionally empty in this release; the consumer (future Na__AssemblyStudio::Na__InteriorDoorSystem hinge builder) will populate them once hinge insertion is in scope.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: Reserved for future use. The Interior Door Configurator does NOT consume this file in the current release - the field Na__Asset__IsReleased is false to make this explicit.
